name: Admin Proposal Send
description: Send a proposal to a client via email from the proposals list (actions modal) or from the edit page. The email body now interpolates the editable email_intro field from the proposal and the commercial PDF is attached automatically. Backend returns email_delivery: {ok, reason, detail}; when ok=false, the panel surfaces a red toast with the reason (placeholder_email, template_disabled, send_failed) instead of generic success.
knownGaps: The server-side PDF-attachment side effect on send is backend-only and not asserted at the UI layer.
